race.comment: WOOTTON PLEASE (9) did little at Mudgee last start when clearly below her best but her form prior to that was right up to this. Has good early speed and will give them something to catch. CHAMP DE MARS (8) has been thereabouts recently, the latest result a fourth beaten at Gulargambone over 1200m. Best form puts her right in this. BROADCAST BOOGIE (11) ran well despite being friendless in betting last time over the mile at Moree, finishing second and beaten less than a length. Deserves more respect this time. PANELLI (2) doesn't win out of turn but ran a nice race last time out at Narromine, finishing a close second. Looks well placed so expect a bold display.
